rot.terceira.demos.colada.1: Attacking demonstration: the black king has already left the edge and stands right next to the rook on g6, to protect it. How do you drive the rook back to the second rank?
rot.terceira.demos.colada.2: Check on h7, along the seventh rank. If the king goes to e8 or f8, the queen captures the rook on g6 next move.
rot.terceira.demos.colada.3: The rook blocks the check on g7 and returns to the second rank, beside the king, but it attacks the queen on h7.
rot.terceira.demos.colada.4: The queen leaves with check on f5, along the f-file. If it captured the rook on g7, the king would recapture: a draw.
rot.terceira.demos.colada.5: The king goes to g8, beside the rook: this is the second-rank defence, and the plan now is the one from the previous chapter.
rot.terceira.demos.espeto.1: Defensive demonstration: in the chapter's position, White put the queen on f5 instead of f4. Now let us think from Black's side: what resource does the rook have?
rot.terceira.demos.espeto.2: Check on b5, along the fifth rank, with the white king between the rook and the queen: a skewer, the only move that saves Black.
rot.terceira.demos.espeto.3: The white king steps out of check to e6, still beside the queen.
rot.terceira.demos.espeto.4: The rook captures the queen, even though it is protected: the rook trades itself for it.
rot.terceira.demos.espeto.5: The white king recaptures, and only the two kings remain: a draw. On d6, away from the queen, the white king would let it fall for nothing.
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.1: Attacking demonstration: after the queen went to f4, the rook fled to a6, far from the king. Without its protection, how do you win it?
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.2: Check on b8, along the eighth rank. The black king cannot reach a6, and the queen prepares the fork.
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.3: The black king steps out of check to e7.
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.4: Fork: check along the seventh rank and an attack on the rook on a6, along the diagonal.
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.5: The black king steps out of check, and nothing protects the rook.
rot.terceira.demos.garfo.6: The queen captures the rook: rook won.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the black rook is on b6, on Black's third rank, the board's sixth, two ranks in front of the king. This is the third-rank defence: the rook shuts the sixth rank to your king.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.e2: It is the most resilient defence, and your king cannot get through. The plan: take squares from the rook with the queen until it returns beside the king, on the second rank, a defence you already know how to break.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l1: The queen drops back to f4, without check, and watches e3 and b8. Now every rook move loses it within a few moves, and the king on e7 or e8 runs into a forking check on e3.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l2: The black king leaves the edge via d7, the most resilient defence. On c8, your king would advance to c5 and attack the rook.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l3: Check on a4, along the diagonal to d7. On d8 or e7, the king would let the rook fall within a few moves.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l4: The black king goes to c7, right next to the rook on b6, to protect it.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l5: Check along the seventh rank, and the queen also attacks the rook. If the king goes to c8 or d8, it stops protecting the rook, and the queen captures it.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l6: The rook blocks the check on b7 and escapes the attack, but it goes back beside the king, on the second rank.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l7: The rook attacks the queen on a7. The queen leaves with check on c5, along the c-file, and the black king must respond.
rot.terceira.ideia.ex1.l8: The king goes to b8, beside the rook: this is the second-rank defence. The third-rank defence is over, and the plan now is the one from the previous chapter.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.entrega.1: The queen captures the rook, but the black king was protecting it: it recaptures, only the two kings remain, and it is a draw.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.entrega.2: Capture the rook only when it is unprotected. Beside the king, it falls to the plan, not to a trade.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.espeto.1: The rook checks along the line joining your king to the queen: a skewer. The king steps out of check, and the rook captures the queen.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.espeto.2: Do not leave the queen behind your king, on the same rank or file, if the rook can check from the other side.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.solta.1: The queen was left unprotected, within reach of the rook or the black king: it is captured, and now Black is the one winning.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.solta.2: Before each move, check that the queen's new square is protected or out of reach of the rook and the black king.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.troca.1: The rook captures the queen, and your king recaptures: only the two kings remain, and it is a draw.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.troca.2: On the rook's line and protected only by the king, the queen can be traded. Put the queen where the rook cannot reach it.
rot.terceira.pratica.fins.afogado: A draw: the black king is stalemated. When its king has almost no squares, prefer a check or a move that leaves it a free square.
rot.terceira.pratica.fins.insuficiente: The queen and the rook left the board, and the material is not enough: a draw. Before each move, check whether the rook can capture the queen.
rot.terceira.pratica.fins.limite: The move limit ran out before the rook fell. First, force the rook back beside the king; then follow the second-rank plan.
rot.terceira.pratica.fins.repeticao: A draw by repetition. Instead of returning to the same position, take a square from the rook with every queen move.
rot.terceira.pratica.fora.fim: End of the chapter: against the rook on the third rank, the queen takes its squares until the rook returns to the second rank, and the second-rank defence falls too.
rot.terceira.pratica.fora.p: Attack: now the black king has already left the edge and protects the rook, on the third rank. Win the rook: with checks, separate the rook from the king or drive it back to the second rank.
rot.terceira.pratica.lado.fim: Rook won. The queen took the rook's squares on the third rank, and it went back beside the king, where the previous chapter's plan won it.
rot.terceira.pratica.lado.p: Attack: White again. The rook is on Black's third rank and shuts the sixth to your king. Win the rook: first, force it back beside the king.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.cravada.1: The rook attacks your queen on your king's line, protected by the black king: the queen is pinned. Taking the rook leaves only the two kings, and it is a draw.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.cravada.2: Before each move, check whether the rook, protected by the black king, can attack the queen on your king's line.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.espetoTroca.1: The rook checks on the line joining your king and queen: it is a skewer. The king steps out of check, the rook takes the queen, and your king recaptures: only the two kings remain, and it is a draw.
rot.terceira.pratica.err.espetoTroca.2: Do not leave the queen behind your king, on the same rank or file, if the rook can check from the other side.
